objects.what: red glossy drip running from the heel down and forming a three-tine pitchfork stuck into the cake
chocolate drip cake on a white pedestal cake stand, with glaze puddles on the plate and a soft shadow under the stand

notes: No text, logos or watermark anywhere. The shoe, drip and cake form one connected group: the drip from the heel becomes a red pitchfork whose tines go into the cake. This is a deliberate surreal device but reads as melted, liquid red. The heel tip and the start of the drip blend a little where they meet at about x 45-47, y 26-30. The shoe floats with no shadow on the backdrop. The glaze is very glossy and slightly CG-looking. The cake crumb and the stand look clean, with no obvious artefacts. The whole right side (x 58-100) and the top-left corner are empty white space, usable for copy.
